title.narrative: Improving the core functions of primary health care in Botswana

description.narrative: This research project aims to implement the newly developed and content-validated regional version of the PCAT for sub-Saharan Africa, which focuses on the five core functions of high-quality primary care in alignment with the WHO’s measurement framework. The scope in Botswana includes translating the tool into Setswana, piloting and deploying it through cross-sectional surveys in one health district, and supporting stakeholder engagement to interpret the findings and co-design district-level quality improvement plans.

To measure the core functions of primary care in North West district. To engage local stakeholders in the PCAT findings and plan interventions to improve the quality of primary care. To engage regional stakeholders in the use of PCAT as part of a package of measurement tools for countries in sub-Saharan Africa
